entries.title: Shared goals and preferences
entries.text: Synthetic CARE-Link exercise: ask the person which goal matters most to them. Keep their own words and show unanswered questions without inventing an answer.
entries.source_title: Ontario Health major depression resources; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise

entries.title: Objectifs et préférences partagés
entries.text: Exercice fictif CARE-Link : demandez à la personne quel objectif compte le plus pour elle. Conservez ses propres mots et indiquez les questions sans réponse sans inventer de réponse.

entries.title: Prepare a complete handoff
entries.text: Synthetic CARE-Link exercise: prepare the person’s stated goals, attributed observations, unresolved questions and permitted contact details. Record the receiving service’s actual response separately from the draft.
entries.source_title: Ontario Health transitions resources; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise
entries.license: CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise; repository use only. Referenced publisher content is not reproduced or clinically approved.

entries.title: Préparer un transfert complet
entries.text: Exercice fictif CARE-Link : préparez les objectifs exprimés par la personne, les observations attribuées, les questions en suspens et les coordonnées autorisées. Consignez la réponse réelle du service destinataire séparément du brouillon.
entries.source_title: Ontario Health transitions resources; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise
entries.license: CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise; repository use only. Referenced publisher content is not reproduced or clinically approved.

entries.title: Prepare questions for the worker
entries.text: Synthetic CARE-Link exercise: separate a carer’s report from the person’s report. Prepare questions for the worker when reports disagree. A relationship does not grant permission to share private information.
entries.source_title: CAMH information resources; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise
entries.license: CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise; repository use only. Referenced publisher content is not reproduced or clinically approved.

entries.title: Préparer des questions pour l’intervenant
entries.text: Exercice fictif CARE-Link : distinguez le récit du proche de celui de la personne. Préparez des questions pour l’intervenant lorsque les récits divergent. Le lien familial ne donne pas le droit de partager des renseignements privés.
entries.source_title: CAMH information resources; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise
entries.license: CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise; repository use only. Referenced publisher content is not reproduced or clinically approved.

entries.title: Keep handoff status accurate
entries.text: Synthetic CARE-Link exercise: a prepared package is unsent. A dispatch acknowledgement does not establish that care began. If a receipt is missing, keep the outcome unknown and prepare an unsent follow-up for the responsible worker.
entries.source_title: HL7 FHIR Task lifecycle; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise
entries.license: CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise; repository use only. Referenced publisher content is not reproduced or clinically approved.

entries.title: Conserver un état de transfert exact
entries.text: Exercice fictif CARE-Link : un dossier préparé n’est pas envoyé. Un accusé d’envoi ne prouve pas que les soins ont commencé. Si la réception n’est pas confirmée, conservez un résultat inconnu et préparez un suivi non envoyé pour l’intervenant responsable.
entries.source_title: HL7 FHIR Task lifecycle; background reference for a CARE-Link-authored synthetic exercise

entries.title: Clinical reference: shared decision-making
entries.text: Reference only: Ontario Health’s major depression standard describes treatment decisions made jointly by the person and clinician, taking the person’s values, preferences and recovery goals into account. Its scope covers adults and adolescents aged 13 or older and excludes postpartum depression. Applicability requires professional review; this passage does not establish a diagnosis or select treatment.
entries.source_title: Ontario Health, Major Depression, October 2025, quality statement 3 (page 17); CARE-Link paraphrase, reference only
entries.license: Paraphrase with publisher attribution. Source snapshot retained for research; publisher terms apply. No clinical qualification or publisher endorsement. French translation is not independently language-reviewed.

entries.title: Référence clinique : prise de décision partagée
entries.text: Référence seulement : la norme de Santé Ontario sur la dépression clinique décrit une décision de traitement prise conjointement par la personne et le clinicien, en tenant compte des valeurs, des préférences et des objectifs de rétablissement. Elle vise les adultes et les adolescents de 13 ans ou plus et exclut la dépression post-partum. Un professionnel doit vérifier son applicabilité; ce passage ne pose aucun diagnostic et ne choisit aucun traitement.
entries.source_title: Ontario Health, Major Depression, October 2025, statement 3, page 17; CARE-Link paraphrase and French translation, reference only
